description: Legacy Service Partners is a PE-backed platform that partners with local HVAC, plumbing, and electrical service companies across the U.S., providing capital, centralized platform services and go-to-market support while preserving local operators. Founded in 2021 and backed by Gridiron Capital, Legacy has rapidly scaled via add-on partnerships and now operates across ~19 states with 22–33+ partner brands and a large installed customer base.

matching_clients.rationale: Platform roll-up of residential HVAC/plumbing/electrical brands — same tri‑trade residential services model.
Residential HVAC, plumbing & electrical platform — identical business model and channel.
Multi-brand residential HVAC/plumbing/electrical platform — similar roll-up strategy and services mix.
Residential HVAC & plumbing platform — same sector and operational footprint.
Commercial HVAC & building controls — similar HVAC service lines but focused on commercial customers.
Electrical & specialty contracting — overlap on electrical services and skilled-trades field operations.
Fleet maintenance services — relevant to fleet & vehicle spend but different end market and service offering.

spend_categories.category: Direct Materials & Major Equipment (parts, HVAC units, water heaters)
Freight / Inbound Logistics (receiving parts, unit deliveries)
IT Services & Software (ServiceTitan, scheduling, CRM, SaaS)
Marketing & Advertising (digital PPC, local SEO, brand marketing)
Temp Labor / Contingent Workforce (seasonal helpers, call center temp staff)
Fleet / Vehicles & Fuel (fuel, maintenance, vehicle procurement)
Telecom & Connectivity (mobile, data plans, connectivity for field ops)

key_opportunities: 1) Direct materials & equipment sourcing: consolidating vendor agreements and national distributor terms (largest absolute savings opportunity, ~ $1.35MM). 2) Consolidate IT/SaaS and telecom (ServiceTitan, scheduling, mobile/data) to remove duplicate contracts and volume‑price (IT+telecom savings ~ $0.97MM). 3) Marketing & benefits optimization: centralize media buying and benefits plan design to capture scale (combined ~ $1.02MM).
